title: Fix role selection modal not displaying on login

requirements.text: Debug and fix the ProfileSetupModal in App.tsx to ensure it displays immediately when a user logs in without a role set in their profile, and verify the modal properly captures the user's role selection (parent or child)

quotes: no child and parent options are showed up

acceptanceCriteria: Modal appears automatically on login when userProfile.role is undefined or null
Modal displays both 'Parent' and 'Child' radio button options clearly
User can select either parent or child role
Modal does not close until a valid role is selected and saved

requirements.text: Verify the role selection state management in App.tsx correctly detects when userProfile is loaded from the backend and the role field is undefined, then triggers the modal to open
acceptanceCriteria: Console logs show userProfile data structure when fetched from backend
Console logs confirm when role is undefined and modal should open
Modal open state is set to true when conditions are met
No race conditions prevent modal from appearing

requirements.text: Ensure the updateUserProfile mutation in App.tsx successfully saves the selected role to the backend and refetches the user profile to reflect the updated role
acceptanceCriteria: Selected role (parent or child) is passed to updateUserProfile mutation
Backend updateUserProfile method receives and saves the role
Success callback refetches user profile query
Updated userProfile includes the newly saved role
Console logs confirm successful role save operation

requirements.text: Add enhanced debug logging to ProfileSetupModal component lifecycle to trace modal render state, visibility conditions, user profile data, and role selection flow
acceptanceCriteria: Log when ProfileSetupModal component mounts and unmounts
Log the current value of isOpen state whenever it changes
Log userProfile data when it updates, highlighting the role field
Log when role selection buttons are clicked and what value is selected
Log when handleRoleSelect is called and the mutation is triggered

requirements.text: Verify the backend getUserProfile method in main.mo correctly returns the complete UserProfile object including the role field for authenticated users
acceptanceCriteria: getUserProfile returns UserProfile with all fields including role
When role is not set, it returns as null/undefined
When role is set, it returns the exact Role variant (Parent or Child)
No data is lost or corrupted in the response

constraints: Do not modify the backend data model structure for UserProfile or Role
Preserve existing authentication flow using Internet Identity
Maintain all existing debug logging that was added in previous versions
nonGoals: Changing the visual design of the role selection modal
Adding additional role types beyond parent and child
Modifying permission request or approval functionality
